operational_relevance: Incorrect PASS can conceal unsupported analysis.
uncertainty: Small deterministic corpus; no population inference is claimed.
noise_policy: Retain all repetitions and report range.
pareto_treatment: A candidate is selected only when hard constraints hold and incorrect PASS decreases.
normalization: Counts use the same frozen evaluator categories.
contamination_controls: Final evaluation inputs are withheld from the repair feedback process.
useful_benefit_threshold: At least one fewer incorrect PASS without a hard-constraint regression.
limitations: Developer-controlled evaluation is not organizationally independent.
